**Finding: IP — compliant (preferred position).**

The ownership and data provisions already sit at our preferred level:

- **Deliverables/work product:** §14.2 — Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for it, with a present assignment of all worldwide right, title and interest, equivalent personnel assignments, and further assurances. The §1.4 definition expressly covers "other work product."
- **Vendor pre-existing IP:** §14.3 — Vendor retains only Vendor Technology, defined (§1.9) as its pre-existing technology and expressly excluding Customer Data and Customer's pre-Effective-Date IP.
- **Embedded Vendor IP licence:** §13.2 — perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business, with pre-delivery identification of material Vendor Technology in §14.3.
- **Customer Data:** §14.1 — Customer owns all Customer Data and Customer IP; no right transfers to Vendor except processing solely to provide, secure, support and improve the Services for Customer (service delivery, not independent exploitation), reinforced by §15.1's bars on sale, advertising, commingling and model training.
- **No joint ownership:** §14.4, plus a feedback provision limited to generalized suggestions with our own rights unrestricted.

Noted in the rationale but not redlined: Deliverable ownership is subject to payment of applicable Fees, and §13.3 allows licence suspension during a material uncured payment/use breach after notice and cure — customary qualifications short of the ideal wording, not fallback failures. No redline proposed.
